prerequisites: Minimum 80% of basic and compulsory credits (164.4 credits)

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to individually carry out, present and defend before a university committee a project in the field of Mechanical Engineering of a professional nature, synthesizing and integrating the competencies acquired in the studies.

syllabus_topics: Mechanics of continuous media and theory of structures
Documentation and analysis of works or projects related to construction management, industrial organization, production process management, budget monitoring, safety coordination and quality control
Engineering projects belonging to the field of Mechanical Engineering
Practical application of Research and Development works related to Mechanical Engineering
Works carried out in academic exchange programs with other universities, Spanish or foreign
Any other that the Degree Commission or sub-commission it delegates to considers valid for this purpose

assessment_methods.method: Technical Content of the Final Degree Project
Oral Defense of the Final Degree Project

assessment_rules: To pass the course, the committee must award the student a final grade equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 for the documentation presented and oral defense.
